memory_findings.claim: The searched surface is one instrument on one day in one continuity segment, traversed forward-only on ts_recv_ns with no integrity defect. 57,027 native MBO records closed into 43,569 F_LAST groups, every one of them closed; 0 cursor discontinuities, 0 duplicate group indices, 0 FIFO reconstruction failures. Session phase is not balanced: 43,366 groups (99.53%) are PRE_SETTLEMENT and 203 (0.47%) are PRE_OPEN, and all 19 lawful invocation cutoffs fall in PRE_SETTLEMENT. Every statement below is therefore a statement about a Sunday PRE_SETTLEMENT tape for instrument_id 111313, not about natural gas generally.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: These are counters and hash-bound receipts, not estimates, and three of them (records_seen, groups_seen, groups_f_last_closed) are reconciled against ledger rows actually read back from disk (exact_member_ledger rows_read_back_from_disk = 43,569).

evidence.session_assignment_basis: recomputed from ts_event_ns via the CME session rule (D6); phase_mismatches 0, segment_mismatches 0

memory_findings.falsifier: Any of: a second instrument_id in the queue-observation instrument list; segments_opened > 1; a nonzero value in cursor_discontinuities / duplicate_group_indices / fifo_reconstruction_failures; or a phase histogram in which PRE_OPEN is more than a rounding fraction of groups.

memory_findings.claim: The causal candidate detector could only search 36.6% of the seconds it observed, and it rejected 98.0% of what it did search. Of 17,991 observed seconds, 11,399 (63.4%) sat in warm-up because the trailing causal quantile had not yet accumulated its 600 required observations, leaving 6,592 searchable seconds. Within those, 4,462 second-events were considered and 91 promoted: 2,053 suppressed by prominence, 1,672 below the trailing 0.85 quantile, 338 zero-magnitude, 294 inside the 45 s refractory, 14 not a local maximum. The 91-candidate population is therefore a 2.04% survivor set of a search that itself covered a third of the day.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: Every number is an explicit rejection counter emitted by the detector itself, and they sum: 91+2053+1672+338+294+14 = 4,462.

evidence.runner_note: 'a causal bar finds a different set than the frozen whole-day quantile ... reproducing the frozen 3,429 would be the warning sign, not the goal'

memory_findings.falsifier: If seconds_in_warmup were a small fraction of seconds_observed, or if the promoted share were of the same order as the considered count, the candidate population would be a census rather than a tail sample and every per-candidate rate below would carry a different denominator.

memory_findings.claim: Three of the mission's four clocks were populated and the fourth was not. Event time, first-component receive time and F_LAST availability all produced observations; the decision/as-of clock produced none. f_last_to_decision_delay_ns is empty in all 205 strata with excluded_missing_members summing to exactly 43,569 - every member excluded. This is an absence in the delivered evidence, not a market fact: on this run the decision clock is identical to, or unrecorded against, F_LAST availability, so no claim in this artifact can separate 'lawfully knowable' from 'acted upon'.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The exclusion counter equals the member count exactly, which distinguishes 'measured and found to be zero' from 'never measured'. A measured-zero would have produced n=43,569 with value 0, not n=0 with 43,569 excluded.
memory_findings.falsifier: A single stratum of 4.5 f_last_to_decision_delay_ns with n > 0.

memory_findings.claim: The day's event-group population is extremely concentrated and has a long open-world tail that was preserved rather than collapsed. 205 exact family x subfamily x side x phase strata cover 43,569 members; the four largest strata are 71.5% of all members and the top eleven are 95.5%. 123 strata (60%) hold exactly one member and 154 hold three or fewer. 80.9% of groups carry a single action (35,231 of 43,569), 15.5% carry two, and the component count runs to a single 245-action group. Singletons were retained with their own deterministic IDs, so no rare structure was folded into a nearest-neighbour label.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The per-stratum n values sum exactly to 43,569, the member count, so the census is complete rather than a sample.
memory_findings.falsifier: If the singleton strata had been absorbed into their nearest large family the strata count would drop toward the seed-family count (~20) and the component histogram would truncate. It does neither.

memory_findings.claim: The carried seed vocabulary crosswalks cleanly onto the discovered open-world families, and the crosswalk shows this day is overwhelmingly elementary queue traffic, not cascade traffic. Reading each family's literal action|side node set: elementary add A = 16,199 groups, elementary cancel C = 15,136, elementary modify M = 3,896, add-with-neutral-close AN = 3,727, CN = 2,182, MN = 794. The trade-bearing seeds are two orders of magnitude rarer: TFCN = 812, TFC = 162, TFM = 139, TFFCCN = 32. The lifecycle shape the mission names as worth recognising, AN -> TFMN -> TFCN, is not observable as a group family on this slice because no TFMN family appears at all; TFM (no neutral close) does.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The crosswalk is derived from each family's literal node membership in 4.14, independently of the family hash, and every family's node run counts equal its group count, so the mapping is one-to-one and not inferred.
memory_findings.falsifier: A family whose node set matches a carried seed but was given an open-world ID with no crosswalk, or a carried seed with zero observed groups that I have reported as present. TFMN is reported as absent precisely because no family's node set is T,F,M,N.

memory_findings.claim: A cascade grammar deeper than anything in the carried vocabulary is present and was preserved with its own open-world identity. Every group of 25 or more components in PRE_SETTLEMENT has the same shape: an alternating run of trade/fill pairs against one resting side, terminated by a single uninterrupted mass-cancel run on the SAME side that was being filled, then the neutral close. Cascade multiplicities of 8 to 17 fill/cancel pairs are routine at that size, and one group (ow-808a07548a26d559efdb, 59 components) is a single unsided trade followed by an unbroken run of 28 fills and then 21+6 cancels - 5.6x deeper than the deepest carried seed (TFFFFFCCCCCN, five fills). None of these was coerced to the nearest seed; each carries a content-derived ID. I propose the durable discovered name CONTACT_RUN_TERMINAL_SWEEP for the shape T(F T F ...)^k C^k N, kept distinct from the carried TFTFCCN.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: Each exemplar is one exact group, not an average, and the run structure comes from 4.14's maximal-run decomposition whose run lengths sum exactly to each family's component count (e.g. 59-component group: 1+28+21+6+1+1+1 = 59).

evidence.invariant: in every listed exemplar the terminal cancel run is on the same side as the fills (F|A -> C|A, F|B -> C|B)

memory_findings.falsifier: A group of 25+ components in which the terminal cancel run is on the opposite side to the fills, or in which the terminal disposition is a modify run rather than a cancel run, would break the invariant. A single such exemplar would demote this from a grammar to a tendency.

memory_findings.claim: Mission hypothesis 6 - that mass groups at a session boundary anchor session-state transitions - is confirmed in form but corrected in mechanism. The single PRE_OPEN mass group (ow-60a4de52700419214f4b, 245 components) is not a mass CANCEL and not a mass ADD by market participants: it is one book RESET followed by 154 bid-side and 90 ask-side snapshot adds that restate the book. The traversal counted exactly 244 snapshot_adds_not_born and 1 reset_cleared_book, so no order lifecycle opened from it and no birth time was fabricated. Its formation latency - first component to F_LAST - is 10,436.76 SECONDS (2.9 hours), and its event-to-receive latency median is 253.8 ms against a 106 us day median.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: Three independent counters agree on the same 244/1 decomposition: the 4.14 run lengths, the queue-observation snapshot_adds_not_born counter, and the replenishment refused_row_classes BOOK_RESET counter.
memory_findings.falsifier: If snapshot_adds_not_born were 0 and 244 lifecycles had opened, the group would be participant liquidity rather than a book restatement, and the queue-survival results for PRE_OPEN-born orders (F-15) would be contaminated by it.

memory_findings.claim: No exhaustion runway completed on this slice. 91 runways opened, 0 completed, 0 still open, and 91 censored; 90 were recorded as reversed and 1 censored before reversal. Only two open-world structural states were discovered (OW_1b406d5ef0b2d32d, OW_fa0c9c97f63e8551) and they are perfectly side-locked - the first appears in 59 side-A strata and never on B, the second in 50 side-B strata and never on A - so on this day the discovered state is a re-encoding of side, not an independent structural axis. Four of the eleven carried runway phases were observed (SEARCHED, BIRTH, PERSISTENCE, REVERSAL); seven were not, and discovered_phases is empty.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: completed=0 is not inferred from an empty average: the excluded_missing_members counter on completed_runway_duration_ns is exactly 91, the full candidate population, so every candidate was tested for completion and none qualified.
memory_findings.falsifier: A single stratum of completed_runway_duration_ns with n > 0, or an occurrence of either open-world state on the opposite side, would falsify the completion claim and the side-lock claim respectively.

memory_findings.claim: The REVERSAL phase duration in 4.10 is a censoring artifact and must not be read as a persistence measure. Every REVERSAL duration and every censored_runway_age in the artifact shares the identical nanosecond remainder 372,071,705, which means they all end at one common wall-clock instant - the end of the observation window - while BIRTH and PERSISTENCE durations are exact multiples of 1e9 ns because the underlying dipole substrate is per-second. So the apparent 'median reversal of 1,717 s to 5,615 s' is the remaining observation window after reversal onset, not how long a reversal lasted. Anyone quoting it as a duration is quoting the position of the stream end.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The constant remainder appears in two independently-computed measures (phase_duration_ns for REVERSAL and censored_runway_age_ns) that the contract defines differently, which is only possible if both terminate at the same censoring instant.
memory_findings.falsifier: If REVERSAL durations were genuine phase lengths, their nanosecond remainders would be distributed like any other elapsed measure rather than being one repeated constant across 91 members and 28 strata.

memory_findings.claim: The exhaustion runway received no book mechanics at all. phase_depletion and phase_refill are exactly 0.0 for every one of 344 observations across all 109 state x phase x family x side strata - mean, p50, min and max all zero, with zero exclusions. This is not a market finding that nothing depleted; the exclusion counters are zero, so the measure ran and was handed zeros. Section 4.10's depletion and refill channels are unfed on this run, which is why no runway can be described in terms of liquidity consumption and why the exhaustion sections cannot yet be joined to 4.7 and 4.8.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The same run's 4.7 and 4.8 sections show large nonzero depletion and replacement quantities over the same 43,569 groups, so a zero in 4.10 is a wiring absence, not a quiet tape.

evidence.contrast: 4.7 over the same day recorded 24,283 replenishment episodes with removed and replaced quantities in the tens of thousands of lots

memory_findings.falsifier: Any 4.10 phase_depletion or phase_refill stratum with a nonzero maximum.

memory_findings.claim: Pre-birth prediction is unreachable by construction on this run and the reported 100% detection share is a tautology, not a result. All 91 candidates are H+N; PRIOR = 0, T0 = 0, MISSED = 0, CENSORED = 0, and detection_share = 1.0 in all 28 family x side strata. The runner states the reason plainly: the candidate unit is a dipole flow spike whose birth IS its own detection, so a PRIOR call would be backdating. The population denominator here is the set of events the detector defined, so this figure says nothing about how much exhaustion the detector missed - the missed population is the 4,371 rejected second-events of F-02, which by construction have no birth and therefore no detection time.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The claim is about the estimand, not the numbers: it rests on the runner's own declared unit definition plus prior_lead_ns having 0 strata, which is the structural signature of an unreachable outcome class rather than an empty one.

evidence.runner_note: 'PRIOR requires a precursor signal that precedes the spike; a candidate whose birth is its own detection can only ever be recognised at H+N'

memory_findings.falsifier: A PRIOR outcome would require a precursor feature computed on a clock strictly earlier than the spike second; the run carries no such feature, so producing one - and showing a nonzero prior_lead_ns stratum - falsifies this.

memory_findings.claim: Recognition delay is second-quantized and hits a hard ceiling. Across the full population of 91 the observed H+N delays run from 6 s to exactly 50,000,000,000 ns (50 s) with nothing beyond; 24 members sit in strata where every member is at the 50 s ceiling, and the ceiling is the modal value in 11 of the 28 strata. Ceiling-censored recognition means the reported delays are a lower bound on how long recognition would have taken for the slowest members, and the population mean of 42.6 s is pulled toward the cap by construction. The fastest strata are worth naming individually: ow-6bf0a7fc457bfdc752d3 side A at 7 s (n=1), ow-a64490c46039fdefea7c side A at 20 s (n=1), ow-c9af7252f0e917ab6cba side A at 22 s (n=1), and ow-3a12d9bd4a731b597f0d side A with a minimum of 6 s over n=11.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: All 91 members are in the denominator - no member was dropped for lacking a delay - and every stratum minimum and maximum is an exact integer multiple of 1e9 ns, which is the signature of a per-second substrate rather than of rounding.
memory_findings.falsifier: A single member with a delay above 50 s would falsify the ceiling reading; a delay that is not an integer number of seconds would falsify the quantization reading.

memory_findings.claim: The first-call rule was never exercised, so this run provides no evidence that it works. failed_state_count is 0 for every one of the 91 candidates in all 28 strata, and superseded_call_attempts is 0. No earlier ambiguous or failed causal state was recorded before any recognition, and no later, better-looking horizon ever competed with an earlier valid call. Censored is not negative here: the protection exists and was simply never tested.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: Reported as an untested guard rather than a working one, because a zero here is indistinguishable from a guard that never fired and this run cannot separate the two.
memory_findings.falsifier: Any candidate with failed_state_count > 0, or a nonzero superseded_call_attempts, on a longer slice.

memory_findings.claim: Resting-order survival on this tape is two-population, not one distribution with a tail, and the survival estimator makes it visible where a mean would have hidden it. In the dominant bid-add birth stratum (ow-3a12d9bd4a731b597f0d, side B, PRE_SETTLEMENT, 8,534 orders, 8,260 events, 274 censored) 10% of orders are gone by 1.19 ms while the median lives 3.19 s, a quarter survive past 17.0 s, a tenth past 105.9 s, and 2.74% are still resting at 7,196 s. The dominant ask-add stratum (ow-f6ba7eaa9e45ef1b68cf, side A, 7,527 orders, 7,265 events, 262 censored) is the same shape with a shorter median (2.60 s) and a heavier far tail (10% past 182.1 s, 5% past 1,163 s, 2.36% still resting at 7,195 s). The sub-millisecond decile and the multi-hour survivors are the same book.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The arithmetic means of resolved lifetime (60.8 s and 84.9 s) sit between the 75th and 90th survival percentiles and describe no typical order, which is exactly why the contract mandates the estimator; the curve is computed over all 8,534 and 7,527 orders with censored members lowering the at-risk set.
memory_findings.falsifier: If the survival curve were single-population log-normal, S=0.9 and S=0.5 would differ by roughly the same factor as S=0.5 and S=0.1. Here S0.9->S0.5 is a factor of 2,683 and S0.5->S0.1 a factor of 33: the curve is not one population.

memory_findings.claim: Orders born at the Sunday reopen are the day's persistent liquidity backbone, and they are a different population from orders born during the session. Ask-side orders born in PRE_OPEN (ow-f6ba7eaa9e45ef1b68cf, 73 orders, 53 events, 20 censored) have a median time-to-exit of 217.4 s and 27.4% still resting at 9,653 s; bid-side PRE_OPEN births (ow-3a12d9bd4a731b597f0d, 65 orders, 38 events, 27 censored) have a median of 755.2 s and 41.5% still resting at 9,892 s. Against the same families' PRE_SETTLEMENT medians of 2.60 s and 3.19 s, that is an 84x and 237x difference in median residence, on a stratum key that differs only in session phase.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The comparison is within one family and one side, changing only the session phase, so it cannot be a family or side effect; and the censored members are kept in the at-risk set rather than dropped.

evidence.note: these are participant orders, not the 244 snapshot adds, which opened no lifecycle (F-07)

memory_findings.falsifier: If the PRE_OPEN survival advantage were an artifact of censoring at the stream end, the PRE_SETTLEMENT strata - which are censored at the same instant - would show comparable final survivals. They show 2.7% and 2.4% against 41.5% and 27.4%.

memory_findings.claim: Queue position is cheap on this tape and priority barely moves. Median volume ahead at order birth is 1 in both dominant single-add strata (ow-3a12d9bd4a731b597f0d side B mean 1.396, p90 3, p99 11, max 30; ow-f6ba7eaa9e45ef1b68cf side A mean 1.570, p90 4, p99 17, max 42), and in the add-with-neutral-close strata the median is 0 - the order arrives at the front. Queue movement is 0 at the median and 1 at p90 in every stratum, with a maximum of 8. Separately, 4,625 of 4,939 modify actions (93.6%) changed price or exceeded the resting size under the declared priority rule, so on this tape a modify is almost always a priority-losing reprice rather than a size trim.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: Volume ahead is measured at birth from the reconstructed FIFO with 0 fifo_identity_violations and 0 events for unknown orders, so the queue state is not inferred from depth deltas.

evidence.declared_distortion: REPRICE_DEPARTURE_BOOKED_AS_CANCEL_AHEAD, 1,214 reprice departures counted as cancels ahead

memory_findings.falsifier: A p50 volume-ahead above 1, or a queue_movement p50 above 0, in either dominant stratum. The 1,214 reprice departures booked as cancels-ahead inflate cancels-ahead and would, if reclassified, make queue movement look smaller still, not larger.

memory_findings.claim: A caveat that governs every 4.6 number: 19,462 of 20,005 tracked lifecycles (97.3%) outlive the group that gave them birth, and 64 are still alive in a different session phase, yet the family, side and phase in their stratum key are stamped at birth and never restamped. So a 4.6 stratum labelled with an add family describes where an order was born, not the conditions it lived through. The runner declares this as BIRTH_GROUP_STRATUM. It does not invalidate the survival curves - birth is a lawful, causally-available label - but it forbids reading them as 'orders in family X behave like this while family X is happening'.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The runner declared the distortion and shipped the counter that sizes it, so the caveat is measured rather than suspected.
memory_findings.falsifier: If lifecycles_outliving_birth_group were small relative to completed_lifecycles, the birth stamp would approximate a contemporaneous label.

memory_findings.claim: Chain depth on this slice is essentially flat: of 21,651 lineage nodes, 21,344 (98.58%) are D0 roots and 307 (1.42%) are D1 descendants. Observed maximum depth is 1. D2 and deeper are ABSENT, not suppressed - the runner imposes no maximum depth. Termination is rare and censoring is the norm: 48 lineages TERMINATED, 21,603 CENSORED_STREAM_END, 0 OPEN and 0 CENSORED_SEGMENT_END. So the mission's D0-D5 anchor range is exercised only at its first rung here, and any claim about deep-chain grammar is unanswerable on this day.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: Depth is reported as a distribution over exact integers rather than a mean, and the run declares no maximum, so the absence of D2+ is an observation about the day rather than a truncation of the method.
memory_findings.falsifier: A single D2 node would falsify the flatness claim; the depth distribution is reported over exact integers with no ceiling.

memory_findings.claim: Interstage delay in the lineage is strictly bimodal by transition type, and the two modes are different mechanisms. Descendants reached by an ADD transition are overwhelmingly instantaneous: 243 of the 249 A-transition descendants have an interstage delay of exactly 0 ns (153 on side B, 90 on side A) - the child enters in the same event group as the parent. Descendants reached by a TRADE transition are separated by real time: side A (n=27) p50 14.7 us, p90 4.08 s, max 15.60 s; side B (n=26) p50 21.5 us, p90 682 us, max 351.4 s. An order-ID lineage step that is an add is a bookkeeping successor; a step that is a trade is a causal one.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The strata are separated by the contract's own transition key, so no pooling was needed to see the split, and the zero mode is exact (mean, p50 and max all 0) rather than merely small.
memory_findings.falsifier: A substantial subpopulation of A-transition descendants with nonzero interstage delay would collapse the bimodality.

memory_findings.claim: Recurrence as delivered is a within-group measure, so cross-group recurrence is unmeasured on this run - and within groups there is essentially none. Maximal run length is exactly 1 in every high-count PRE_SETTLEMENT stratum, and run_duration is 0 in all but 7 strata across the whole day; the only long runs are inside the large cascade groups of F-06 and the reopen snapshot of F-07 (154 and 90). Separately, recurrence_count in 4.10 is 0 for all 91 candidates. So 'this structure happened again' is a question this slice does not answer, and reporting a recurrence rate of zero as a market property would be wrong.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The scope is established by an exact equality between two independently-declared populations (4.14 interarrival_gap_ns n=13,458 and 4.5 within_group_receive_gap_ns n=13,458), not by reading the field name.

evidence.interarrival_scope: consecutive components inside one group; equal to 4.5 within_group_receive_gap_ns population

memory_findings.falsifier: If 4.14's interarrival population were 43,569 or 57,027 rather than 13,458 it would be a cross-group measure. It equals the within-group receive-gap population exactly, which fixes its scope.

memory_findings.claim: More than half of all dipole runway stages have no direction at all. Of 3,454 stages across 90 paths, 1,782 (51.6%) are NO_DIRECTION - signed flow exactly zero - against 896 SHORT (25.9%) and 776 LONG (22.5%). Direction is sourced from SIGNED_FLOW_AND_CAUSAL_MECHANICS and a zero-flow stage is reported as having none rather than being resolved to the prevailing side. Any directional model built on this substrate is operating on 48.4% of its own stages; the remaining 51.6% are not neutral evidence, they are no evidence.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The three counts sum exactly to stages_seen, so no stage was dropped, and the zero class is defined by exact equality to zero rather than by a threshold band.
memory_findings.falsifier: If NO_DIRECTION were an artifact of a coarse flow unit, refining the unit would move stages into LONG/SHORT roughly evenly. The slight SHORT tilt (896 vs 776) is within what one day cannot separate from noise and is not claimed as directional.

memory_findings.claim: Normalized book imbalance and signed flow are decoupled on this tape - which is a positive finding, not a null. Across every family, orientation and stage examined, normalized_imbalance sits in a narrow band around 0.06 (stratum means 0.0337 to 0.0848, and within a single path it moves by at most about 0.01 from BIRTH stage 0 through PERSISTENCE stage 15) while signed flow in the same strata swings from +1.29 to -10.60 and individual members reach -52. The book stays bid-tilted by the same small relative amount whatever the flow does. A model that reads direction, or exhaustion, off the imbalance level on this instrument would be reading a near-constant.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The two measures are computed from different quantities by the contract (imbalance from side depths, signed flow from aggressor-signed trade flow) and are reported in the same stratum keys, so the comparison never crosses a family, orientation or stage index.

evidence.contract_note: normalized imbalance is relative and is never derived from, or combined with, absolute depth

memory_findings.falsifier: A stratum in which normalized_imbalance moves by more than about 0.05 across the stages of one path while signed flow is flat, or the converse, would break the decoupling. None was found among the strata inspected.

memory_findings.claim: SAME and FLIP are near-evenly split and differ in DISPERSION, not in location - and the difference lives in one family. Of 91 episodes, 46 are FLIP, 44 SAME and 1 NO_PREDECESSOR (a segment's first candidate, which the runner refuses to give a fabricated orientation). In the largest candidate family (ow-3a12d9bd4a731b597f0d) the BIRTH stage-0 signed flow of FLIP births (n=14) ranges [-52, +9] with median 0.0 and magnitude mean 8.21, while SAME births (n=7) range [-1, +4] with median +1.0 and magnitude mean 1.86. The medians are nearly the same; the tails are not. In the next three families the contrast does not reproduce, so this is a one-family observation, reported as such.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: Reported as a dispersion difference in one named family because the medians are 0.0 vs +1.0 - a location claim would be unsupported - and because three other families do not reproduce it, which is stated rather than omitted.

evidence.orientation_definition: polarity against the LATEST PREDECESSOR candidate

memory_findings.falsifier: The claim is falsified if the ow-3a12d9 FLIP range narrows to the SAME range once the single -52 member is examined and found to be a different structure; it is confirmed if further days reproduce the tail asymmetry in other families.

memory_findings.claim: Mirror pairing produced nothing, so the mission's third seed hypothesis - that mirrored side sequences organize opposing-pressure and direction-change state - is UNTESTED on this run rather than refuted. paired_mirror_difference has n = 0 in all 1,692 strata with excluded_missing_members totalling 3,454 - every stage was unpaired. Section 4.4's matched-pair layer contributed no averaged rows at all. Absence of a matched support is a different result from a matched support showing no difference, and only the first is what happened here.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The exclusion count equals the full stage population exactly (3,454 = stages_seen), which identifies this as 'no pair was formed' rather than 'pairs formed and differences were zero'.

evidence.missingness_rule: unpaired stages are excluded and counted; they are a different estimand

memory_findings.falsifier: Any 4.12 paired_mirror_difference stratum with n > 0, or any averaged companion row carrying section 4.4.

memory_findings.claim: Post-fill disposition on this tape is CANCEL, not MODIFY, by roughly seven to one, and two independent measurements agree. As a conditional transition probability: F|A -> C|A is 550/1,090 = 0.505 against F|A -> M|A 80/1,090 = 0.073 (6.9:1), and F|B -> C|B is 635/1,085 = 0.585 against F|B -> M|B 73/1,085 = 0.067 (8.7:1). As a family census over whole groups: cancel-terminal trade families (TFCN 812 + TFC 162 = 974 groups) outnumber modify-terminal ones (TFM 139 groups) 7.0:1. This directly answers the mission's first seed hypothesis: same-order cancel versus modify after fill does organize post-fill state, and on this day the organization is overwhelmingly one-sided.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: These are conditional probabilities with their own outgoing denominators, explicitly not filed as averages, and the family-census corroboration is computed from a different layer (group families) than the transition graph.
memory_findings.falsifier: If the cancel-versus-modify split were an artifact of the venue expressing a partial-fill residual as a cancel, the unsided F|N node would not reproduce it. It does: 128 cancels against 29 modifies out of 236.

memory_findings.claim: Trades on this tape almost never sweep. 2,028 trade actions produced 2,411 fill actions - 1.19 fills per trade - and the modal trade consumes exactly one resting order. The aggressor/passive pairing is near-deterministic: T|A -> F|B occurs 823 times out of 917 (0.897) and T|B -> F|A 835 out of 930 (0.898). Aggression is also almost perfectly two-sided: 917 ask-tagged and 930 bid-tagged trade actions, corroborated independently by the per-second substrate, which classified 474 buy seconds and 488 sell seconds by the midpoint rule without ever consulting the tape's own side field.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The occurrence census is reconstructed from run lengths and sums to exactly 57,027 records, and three independent counters (non_mutating_T, legacy trades_seen, and the T-node occurrence total) all give 2,028; add occurrences match the replenishment layer's independent 20,249.

per_second_substrate.midpoint_rule: price vs mid; the tape side field is never consulted

memory_findings.falsifier: A fills-per-trade ratio near 1 could be an artifact of the venue emitting one fill row per trade regardless of how many orders were consumed. It is not: the 59-component group of F-06 emits 28 fill rows for one trade, so the feed does express multi-order consumption when it happens.

memory_findings.claim: The touch is defended two to three orders of magnitude faster than the level behind it, and the comparison holds inside a single family and side, changing only the touch state. For ow-40540069fe5aeddc127b side B the Kaplan-Meier median time-to-restoration is 1.775 ms AT_TOUCH (n=556) against 673.1 ms BEHIND_TOUCH (n=7,636) - a factor of 379. For ow-59ace24da4a485c605b6 side A it is 1.379 ms AT_TOUCH (n=400) against 558.8 ms BEHIND_TOUCH (n=6,501) - a factor of 405. Restoration is not universal: 1,903 of 24,283 episodes were NEVER restored and 51 were censored at the 60 s horizon, and never-restored is kept distinct from not-yet-observed.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The comparison changes exactly one key - touch state - within a single family and side, so it cannot be a family, side, session or day effect; censored and never-restored episodes are held out of the event set rather than counted as slow restorations.

within_family_within_side_pairs.note: this pair does NOT reproduce the effect

memory_findings.falsifier: The ow-7b10d38a8b61511bc611 side-A pair shows a ratio of 1.4, so the effect is not universal across families; it is claimed for the two dominant elementary-cancel families and named as not reproducing in the CN family.

memory_findings.claim: Replenishment is size-dependent behind the touch and size-invariant at the touch, and the two coequal ratio views are what shows it. Behind the touch, mean-of-member-ratios exceeds ratio-of-aggregate-sums by a wide margin - ow-40540069fe5aeddc127b side B 14.86 vs 9.65 (difference 5.21 over n=7,622), ow-59ace24da4a485c605b6 side A 24.34 vs 14.73 (difference 9.61 over n=6,475) - meaning small removals get proportionally far more back than large ones. At the touch the two views nearly coincide: 44.01 vs 42.63 (difference 1.38), 39.37 vs 39.20 (difference 0.17), 34.06 vs 33.60 (difference 0.45). Every one of these differences is labelled COMPLEMENTARY_SCOPE_DIFFERENCE by the runner, and the pattern in the differences, not the level of either ratio, is the finding.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: Both ratio forms are computed by the runner from the same exact numerator and denominator totals and are retained coequally, so the difference is arithmetic, not a modelling choice; and it reverses sign in no stratum inspected.
memory_findings.falsifier: If the behind-touch gap were driven by a handful of tiny-removal outliers, trimming the smallest decile of removals would collapse mean-of-member-ratios toward ratio-of-aggregate-sums. The at-touch strata, which have the same removal size distribution (p50 removed = 1 lot), show no gap, which argues against that reading.

memory_findings.claim: A caveat that reframes every restoration ratio in F-28: the runner attributes each refill to EVERY pending episode in the neighbourhood, so 441,404 refills were attributed across 24,283 episodes - 18.2 attributions per episode. The restoration ratios of roughly 9 to 40 are therefore an ARRIVAL DENSITY measure - how much liquidity lands within one tick and 60 s of a removal - not a net replacement ratio, and must never be read as 'nine to forty lots come back for every lot removed'. The underlying member quantities are small: median removed quantity is 1-2 lots and median replaced 12-67 lots per episode.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The attribution rule is declared by the runner, and its multiplicity is a ratio of two published counters, so the caveat is measured rather than a suspicion about the method.
memory_findings.falsifier: If refills were attributed one-to-one, restoration ratios would fall by roughly the attribution multiplicity toward order 1. The near-equality of the attribution multiplicity (18.2) with the behind-touch mean-of-ratios (14.9-24.3) is the direct evidence for this reading.

memory_findings.claim: Delivered pressure is rare and withdrawal is the norm. Over all 43,569 group-scoped runways the pressure disposition is INDETERMINATE 24,617 (56.5%), ACCOMPANIED_BY_WITHDRAWAL 17,327 (39.8%), ABSORBED_WITHOUT_PRICE_MOVE 1,450 (3.3%), DELIVERED_THROUGH_PRICE 175 (0.40%) and SPARSE 0 - withdrawal outnumbers delivery through price 99 to 1. The INDETERMINATE majority is itself a result: it is the single-action groups, which carry no trade and no measurable depletion, and they contribute n=0 to every 4.8 ratio, so 56.5% of the day's runways supply no absorption evidence at all. No discovered disposition was needed: discovered_disposition_counts is empty, so the carried three plus indeterminate covered every runway.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The five disposition counts sum exactly to runways_scored, so no runway was left unclassified, and the empty discovered-disposition register shows nothing was forced into a carried label to achieve that.
memory_findings.falsifier: If DELIVERED_THROUGH_PRICE were rare only because the runway window is one event group, widening it would raise the count. That is exactly the scope caveat in F-31, and it is why this is reported as a group-scoped disposition census rather than a claim about how often pressure moves price.

memory_findings.claim: Section 4.8's ratios are largely determined by family identity rather than by market behaviour, and two of its channels are empty for a scope reason. Because a family ID IS the literal action string, the absorption and withdrawal ratios are near-degenerate inside a family: ow-3a98bbe15cb2bf0c14ba (n=404) has absorption exactly 0.6667 at mean, p50, p90 AND max, and ow-b13ef7b8d0191e4e0d42 (n=70) exactly 1.0 throughout. The informative variation is between families, not within them. Separately, same_side_replacement_ratio has a zero numerator in all 205 strata and depth_survival_ratio in 166 of 205 - these are not market absences but consequences of a runway scoped to one event group, inside which same-side replacement cannot occur.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The degeneracy is visible in the retained quantiles, which is precisely what the contract keeps quantiles for; a mean alone would have hidden that these ratios have no dispersion.
memory_findings.falsifier: If 4.8's ratios carried behavioural information within a family, their within-family p10 and p90 would differ. In the largest strata min = p10 = p50 = p90 = max, which is the signature of a quantity fixed by the action string.

memory_findings.claim: The touch on this instrument is effectively static within event groups, and the ladder is effectively one price level per side. Of 40,272 ladder transitions, 40,264 (99.98%) are touch_state UNCHANGED against 4 COMPRESSION and 4 EXPANSION. depth_concentration_at_touch is exactly 1.0 in all 20,006 observations where a side was non-empty - all of a side's depth sits at its best price. price_gap_raw is observable in only 196 of 40,272 transitions, because a gap needs two occupied levels on one side. And touch_migration_raw yielded 69 observations with only 2 nonzero: one COMPRESSION of -16 ticks on side B and one EXPANSION of +1 tick on side A. Section 4.9's per-transition companion is therefore a local set-difference view, not a book-wide geometry, and cannot be used to describe how price moved - 4.16 is the channel for that.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: Every claim here is a count with its own exclusion counter, and the exclusion counters sum with the observation counts to the 40,272 transitions in each measure.

evidence.level_births_and_deaths: exact set differences over occupied prices; per-transition and family-determined (an add family gives birth=1 death=0)

relative_imbalance.values_observed: +1.0 or -1.0 only, i.e. one side empty

memory_findings.falsifier: If 4.9's companion described the full book, relative_imbalance would have 40,272 observations spanning [-1,1] rather than 154 observations taking only the values +/-1. That exclusion count is what fixes the scope.

memory_findings.claim: The only multi-level ladder visible on this slice is the Sunday reopen snapshot, and it is sparse and bid-heavy. Within the 245-component PRE_OPEN group the runner observed 120 bid-side gaps (p10 1 tick, p50 8 ticks, p90 46 ticks, max 978 ticks) and 75 ask-side gaps (p10 3 ticks, p50 14 ticks, p90 66 ticks, max 1,380 ticks) - so about 121 occupied bid prices against 76 occupied ask prices, with the ask ladder both sparser and spanning further. That asymmetry is corroborated independently by the snapshot's own composition (154 bid adds against 90 ask adds) and by 4.16, where all 91 candidates carry starting_liquidity_regime DEPTH_SKEW_BID and no other liquidity regime stratum exists on this day.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: Three independent layers agree: the ladder gaps in 4.9, the add composition in 4.14 run lengths, and the liquidity-regime stratum key in 4.16's at-risk table.
memory_findings.falsifier: If the bid-heaviness were an artifact of the snapshot ordering, the 4.16 starting_liquidity_regime would show a mix of regimes across candidates spread over two hours of session. It shows DEPTH_SKEW_BID for all 91.

memory_findings.claim: Observation latency rises monotonically with event-group size, so the largest structural events are the LAST to become lawfully observable - the opposite of what a real-time detector wants. Median event-to-receive latency by component count: 106-192 us at 1 component (35,231 groups), 181-662 us at 2, 354 us to 5.1 ms at 3, ~1.0 ms at 17, and then 118.3 ms for the 24-component group, 300.3 ms for the 59-component mass-fill cascade, and 253.8 ms for the 245-component reopen snapshot. The cascade of F-06 - the single most informative liquidity event of the day - arrived roughly 2,800x later relative to its event time than a routine single add.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The relation is monotone across nine size classes covering 99.9% of members, and it is a serialization claim only - the runner explicitly withholds an economic reading, and so do I.

evidence.runner_note: 'these are serialization and feed timings; an economic reading of them is a separate claim and is not licensed by these numbers'

memory_findings.falsifier: If the latency-size relation were an artifact of the group definition rather than of serialization, single-component groups would not themselves show a heavy tail. They do: p50 106 us, p99 3.0 ms, max 393 ms in one stratum of 8,534.

memory_findings.claim: Formation latency carries family-specific timing, which is the mission's fourth seed hypothesis, and the answer is that it is essentially a component-count clock. Single-component groups have formation latency identically 0 by construction (35,231 members, and 4.5's within_group_receive_gap excludes exactly those 35,231). Two-component families sit at p50 20.1-22.7 us (min 3.2 us, max 145.7 us), four-component families at p50 47.9 us with mean 62.2 us and max 732.0 us, and the reopen snapshot at 10,436.76 s. Within-group action spacing is ~20-28 us at the median across every multi-component family. So the answer to hypothesis 4 is: yes, but the family-specific part is almost entirely explained by how many components the family has, not by which actions they are.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The zero for single-component groups is structural and declared, and I report it as such rather than as a finding that single-action groups form instantly.
memory_findings.falsifier: If formation latency were action-specific rather than count-specific, two 2-component families with different action strings (AN vs CN vs MN) would show materially different medians. They span 19.97-22.66 us - a 13% spread against a 2.4x step from 2 to 4 components.

memory_findings.claim: Price response to a candidate is zero at the median at one second and only develops dispersion, not direction, by sixty. At H+1s the median response is exactly 0 in all 28 strata; at H+10s dispersion opens (largest stratum ow-3a12d9bd4a731b597f0d side B, n=10: p10 -3.0 ticks, p50 0, p90 +1.0, max +7.5); at H+60s it widens further (same stratum: p10 -6.5 ticks, p50 0, p90 +2.0, min -6.5, max +7.5), with the day's extremes at -11.5 ticks and +9.0 ticks. The at-risk denominator is horizon-specific and shrinks: 91 entered, 90 observed at H+1s and H+10s (1 censored), 89 at H+60s (2 censored). Because medians are zero and stratum means change sign between horizons within the same stratum, no directional response claim is supportable from this day.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: Each horizon carries its own at-risk denominator and the censored members are counted rather than dropped, so the widening dispersion cannot be an attrition artifact - only 1 and 2 members leave.

evidence.units: raw price; tick_raw = 1,000,000 = 0.001; half-tick values appear because the response is a midpoint change

memory_findings.falsifier: A directional claim would require a stratum whose sign is stable across the three horizons with a nonzero median. ow-3a12d9bd4a731b597f0d side B flips -0.2, +0.4, -0.7 ticks in stratum mean across the three horizons with a median of 0 at every one, which is the direct counter-evidence.

memory_findings.claim: The exact-to-averaged reconciliation is internally consistent and the granularity difference is labelled, not hidden. 43,569 exact member rows and 243,270 exact lifecycle rows sit beneath 16,293 averaged companion rows summarizing 845,120 observations, and exact_members_present_beneath_summaries is true. Session and segment assignment was recomputed independently from ts_event_ns via the CME rule with 0 phase mismatches and 0 segment mismatches over all 43,569 assignments. Where an averaged row's n does not equal the member count, the runner labels it a COMPLEMENTARY_SCOPE_DIFFERENCE rather than a discrepancy, and every case I checked (4.7 episodes 24,283 vs members 43,569; 4.6 lifecycles 20,005 vs members 43,569; 4.9 transitions 40,272 vs members 43,569) is a genuine estimand difference.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: Every ledger row count was read back from disk after writing and reconciled against an independent counter (rows_read_back_from_disk equals reconciled_against_counter for all three ledgers), so the reconciliation is not a claim about intent.

session_assignment.basis: recomputed from ts_event_ns via the CME session rule (D6)

Sections 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.4 and 4.15 are absent from layers.averaged_companions, whose 16,293 rows cover only 4.5-4.14 and 4.16. For 4.1 and 4.3 that is contract-correct (identity is boolean/count/hash and family description is conditional). memory_findings.confidence_basis: The section census is exhaustive over all 16,293 rows, and the absence is reported rather than papered over with 4.9's per-transition depth numbers, which measure something else (F-32).

The exact member ledger is 10,616,914,801 bytes over 43,569 rows (243,678 bytes per row) and was STREAMED to the box at /opt/frankie-a-arm-run/ledgers/exact_member_rows.jsonl, sha256 153cc761...; the exact lifecycle and runway ledger is 192,510,728 bytes over 243,270 rows, sha256 4ebc5b71...; the legacy observable rows are 29,329,182 bytes over 22,380 rows, sha256 3c75f8b4.... what_i_did_not_read: any section 4.2 daily regime output (not present, see F-38)

memory_findings.claim: Positive hypothesis, assembled from four sections that were computed independently: this instrument runs a CONTACT-THEN-RETREAT-THEN-REFILL micro-cycle whose three legs are each measured. (1) Contact: a trade consumes one resting order (F-26, 1.19 fills per trade) and, in the rare deep cascades, up to 28. (2) Retreat: the filled side cancels rather than reprices, at 6.9-8.7:1 (F-25), and in the large groups the retreat is a single uninterrupted same-side cancel run within the same event group (F-06). (3) Refill: the touch is restored with a median of 1.3-5.0 ms and the level behind it in 559-673 ms (F-27), with far more quantity arriving in the neighbourhood than left (F-28/F-29). The cycle completes inside a handful of milliseconds at the touch, which is why the ladder looks static (F-32) and why median price response at H+1s is exactly zero (F-36).
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The three legs come from three sections computed from different inputs (transition graph, survival estimator, ratio pairs) and are consistent with two further sections (4.9 static touch, 4.16 zero one-second response) that were not used to build them.
memory_findings.falsifier: The cycle is falsified if, on another day, the filled side predominantly MODIFIES rather than cancels, or if at-touch restoration medians are the same order as behind-touch ones. Either would mean the retreat is a resize and the refill is not touch-privileged.

memory_findings.claim: Positive hypothesis: on this feed, information size and observation delay are positively coupled, so a real-time system faces an adverse-selection gradient built into the transport. The five largest groups of the day (245, 59, 50, 49, 47 components) are also among the latest to arrive relative to their event times (253.8 ms, 300.3 ms, 5.3 ms, 1.4 ms, 4.2 ms median event-to-receive) against a 106-192 us median for the single-action groups that make up 80.9% of the tape. The practical form: by the time a mass-fill cascade is lawfully observable, roughly 300 ms of event time has passed, during which the touch has already been restored several times over on the millisecond clock of F-27.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: The baseline is four strata of 6,901-8,534 members each, so the contrast is against a well-populated reference rather than against another rare event; but the large-group side is n=1 per family, which is why this is filed as a hypothesis and not a finding about the feed.
memory_findings.falsifier: If the large-group latency were a per-record cost rather than a per-group one, the 245-component group would be the slowest. It is not - the 59-component group is - so the coupling is not simply proportional to record count, and a test on more days could break the ordering entirely.

memory_findings.claim: PROVISIONAL STRATEGY HYPOTHESIS SH-1, post-contact touch re-entry (maker only). TRIGGER: an F_LAST-closed group whose node sequence contains a fill followed by a same-side cancel run of two or more (the F-06 grammar), observed on the F_LAST availability clock, never earlier. CLOCK: ts_recv_ns of that group's F_LAST. SIDE: post a resting order on the SAME side as the cancel run, at the vacated touch price. ENTRY: passive only. CONTINUATION: hold while the touch remains the same price. EXIT/REVERSAL: cancel if the touch migrates, which on this day happened 8 times in 40,272 transitions. INVALIDATION: the median at-touch restoration of 1.3-5.0 ms is faster than any round trip a non-colocated system can make, so the hypothesis is invalidated for any actor whose reaction time exceeds ~1 ms. HORIZON: the 60 s replenishment window. SIZING: median removed quantity is 1-2 lots, so the natural clip is 1-2 lots and the strategy has no capacity. FEES/FILL: maker-only, and fill probability is governed by the F-16 queue - median volume ahead of 1 - not by size. THIS IS A HYPOTHESIS FROM ONE DAY AND MUST NOT BE EXECUTED.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: Every leg of the trigger and every timing constant is a measured per-stratum quantity from this run; nothing in it uses a completed duration, a future response, or a value unavailable at the F_LAST cutoff. Two days do not establish out-of-sample edge and this is one day.
memory_findings.falsifier: SH-1 is falsified if, on a second day, at-touch restoration medians exceed the actor's round trip by less than an order of magnitude, or if the same-side cancel run is not followed by a same-price refill more often than chance. It is also falsified economically by F-36: median price response at every horizon is zero, so there is no directional component to harvest, only queue position.

memory_findings.claim: PROVISIONAL STRATEGY HYPOTHESIS SH-2, and it is a NEGATIVE one worth recording: do not build a directional trigger on this candidate unit. Three independent measurements say the same thing. 51.6% of dipole stages carry no direction at all (F-21). Median price response at H+1s, H+10s and H+60s is exactly zero in every one of the 28 strata, and stratum means change sign between horizons within the same stratum (F-36). And recognition arrives 6-50 s after birth with a hard ceiling at 50 s (F-12), which is one to two orders of magnitude slower than the mechanics the same run measures in milliseconds. The positive use of the unit on this evidence is as a REGIME or SIZING gate - the FLIP-birth tail of F-23 is a dispersion signal - not as a side selector.
memory_findings.confidence_basis: A negative strategy conclusion is cheap to hold and expensive to ignore; it rests on three measurements built from different inputs (signed flow, forward price at fixed horizons, recognition timing) that would have to fail together.
memory_findings.falsifier: SH-2 is falsified by a stratum with a nonzero median response whose sign is stable across all three horizons, on a population large enough that one day is not the constraint.

memory_findings.claim: What this one-day slice CANNOT answer, marked unanswerable rather than answered thinly. (1) The mission's stream-position gradient - October 1 seen first with nothing accumulated versus October 5 with three days behind it - is by definition cross-day and this run holds only 20211003. (2) Whether any exhaustion runway ever COMPLETES: 91 of 91 are censored at the stream end (F-08), and a completion could only appear in a window longer than the observation. (3) Chain grammar beyond D1: no D2+ node exists here (F-18), so nothing can be said about deep-chain behaviour. (4) Cross-group recurrence, extension and burst structure: 4.14's delivered scope is within-group (F-20). (5) Mirrored-pair structure and mission hypothesis 3: no pair formed (F-24). (6) Cluster identity and any within-cluster description: clustering did not run (NO_CLUSTERING_D5, F-38). (7) Book-regime scale - spread, full-depth imbalance, level counts: section 4.2 is not in this artifact (F-38). (8) Anything about the decision clock or acting delay: it is unpopulated (F-03). (9) Whether the one-instrument, one-segment, 99.5%-PRE_SETTLEMENT character of this Sunday reopen generalises to a weekday session: 43,569 groups on one instrument is roughly 1% of the four-day roster and nothing here bounds the other 99%. (10) Whether the 91-candidate population is representative: it is a 2.04% survivor set of a search covering 36.6% of the day (F-02).
memory_findings.confidence_basis: Every item is tied to a specific counter in this run that is structurally zero or structurally single-valued, so the limitation is a property of the slice rather than of my reading of it.
memory_findings.falsifier: Each item becomes answerable the moment a second scored day is traversed under the same contract; none of them becomes answerable by re-reading this artifact more carefully.
